rules.name: lal-uat-01-diagnose
rules.sql: WITH cut AS ( SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v GROUP BY v.tenant_id, v.business_unit ), expected AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id) d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date, d.active_lots FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d JOIN cut c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit AND d.value_date <= c.d ORDER BY d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date DESC ), actual AS ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.business_unit, l.trade_id, l.value_date, l.active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot l ), j AS ( SELECT coalesce(e.tenant_id, a.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, coalesce(e.business_unit, a.business_unit) AS business_unit, e.trade_id AS e_trade, a.trade_id AS a_trade, (e.value_date IS DISTINCT FROM a.value_date OR e.active_lots IS DISTINCT FROM a.active_lots) AS diff FROM expected e FULL JOIN actual a ON a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = e.business_unit AND a.trade_id = e.trade_id ) SELECT j.tenant_id, j.business_unit, c.d AS cutoff, count(j.e_trade) AS expected_rows, count(j.a_trade) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.a_trade IS NULL) AS missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NULL) AS extra, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.a_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.diff) AS different FROM j LEFT JOIN cut c ON c.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = j.business_unit GROUP BY j.tenant_id, j.business_unit, c.d HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.a_trade IS NULL OR j.e_trade IS NULL OR j.diff) > 0 ORDER BY missing DESC

SELECT d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, count(*) AS history_rows FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = d.business_unit) GROUP BY d.tenant_id, d.business_unit ORDER BY 3 DESC

WITH vrow AS ( SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS cutoff, min(v.created_timestamp) AS valuation_created, max(v.updated_timestamp) AS valuation_updated FROM opera.valuation_date_table v GROUP BY v.tenant_id, v.business_unit ), newest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id) d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.created_timestamp, d.created_by FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d JOIN vrow r ON r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.business_unit = d.business_unit AND d.value_date <= r.cutoff ORDER BY d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date DESC ) SELECT n.tenant_id, n.business_unit, r.valuation_created, r.valuation_updated, count(*) AS missing_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.created_timestamp < r.valuation_created) AS before_valuation_row, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.created_timestamp >= r.valuation_created) AS after_valuation_row, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.created_timestamp IS NULL) AS no_created_timestamp, min(n.created_timestamp) AS first_written, max(n.created_timestamp) AS last_written, string_agg(DISTINCT n.created_by, ', ') AS written_by FROM newest n JOIN vrow r ON r.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND r.business_unit = n.business_unit WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND l.business_unit = n.business_unit AND l.trade_id = n.trade_id) GROUP BY n.tenant_id, n.business_unit, r.valuation_created, r.valuation_updated ORDER BY missing_trades DESC

SELECT c.relname AS table_name, t.tgname, t.tgenabled, CASE t.tgenabled WHEN 'O' THEN 'fires (origin/local)' WHEN 'D' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN 'R' THEN 'replica only' WHEN 'A' THEN 'always' END AS state, p.proname AS function_name, CASE WHEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%fn_lock_active_lot_scope%' THEN 'v2 (locks)' ELSE 'v1' END AS body FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN ('deal_active_lots_table', 'valuation_date_table') ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT run_at, tenant_id, business_unit, cutoff, missing, extra, different, repaired, caller FROM opera.latest_active_lot_reconcile_log ORDER BY run_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id = 'redefine-deal_ticket_active_lots_view-v2-latest-active-lot') AS changeset_recorded, (SELECT max(dateexecuted)::text FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id = 'redefine-deal_ticket_active_lots_view-v2-latest-active-lot') AS changeset_run_at, CASE WHEN pg_get_viewdef('opera.deal_ticket_active_lots_view'::regclass) LIKE '%latest_active_lot%' THEN 'reads latest_active_lot' ELSE 'old window over history' END AS view_reads

SELECT relname, n_tup_ins, n_tup_upd, n_tup_del, n_live_tup, last_autovacuum::text, last_autoanalyze::text, last_analyze::text FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND relname IN ('deal_active_lots_table', 'latest_active_lot', 'valuation_date_table') ORDER BY relname
